draw.what: a coefficient past the DSL's bound

gates.name: failed
gates.reads: a seed or its analysis failed for good
gates.why_not: the rung cannot be completed: nothing is there to let through

gates.name: over_budget
gates.reads: the law's first chunk at the next size, predicted from its own seeds a size below, would not fit that size's budget in work (806)
gates.why_not: a seed that cannot start is not let through: the budget is the design's, fixed before the study

gates.name: cut
gates.reads: a seed of the law ran out of its budget in work before it settled, at the size the law is at: parked there, on a design's cut_gate (841)

gates.name: empty
gates.reads: mean degree at most the empty line at every rung, from 256; on a design's fact_sizes_in_a_row, at that many sizes in a row and not rising (828)

gates.name: disconnected
gates.reads: the largest component under the floor and not growing, from 1,024; on a design's fact_sizes_in_a_row, under it at that many sizes in a row (828)

gates.name: too_dense
gates.reads: mean degree at the campaign's cap, from 256; on a design's fact_sizes_in_a_row, at that many sizes in a row (828)

gates.name: nothing_read
gates.reads: no chain read any probe at any size of the base block, the law parked at its top (782, the first gate on the base block)

gates.name: no_steady_chain
gates.reads: no chain steady and moved by the law from 1,024 to 4,096, the law parked at 4,096 (796)

gates.name: reading_lost
gates.reads: d_s settled and then has no reading at the top rung

gates.name: no_reading
gates.reads: no d_s at either of the top two rungs

gates.name: unsettled_twice
gates.reads: d_s unsettled at two looks in a row

gates.name: no_second_rung
gates.reads: unsettled where the next rung takes a plateau

gates.name: unsettled
gates.reads: a hold on an unsettled step (529's rules, `second_rung: false`)

gates.name: no_plateau
gates.reads: d_s did not settle at the step before a deep rung

gates.name: deep_lane_full
gates.reads: the deep rung's lane is full
gates.why_not: a queue, not a verdict: the law runs when the lane frees, best score first

gates.name: starts_alike
gates.reads: every start ends alike, no shape held, from the last base rung (602)

gates.name: starts_apart_twice
gates.reads: the starts apart with no shape held at two sizes in a row (602)

gates.name: starts_apart_by_history
gates.reads: the starts apart, and every start alike at the size below or the starts in two groups (629)

gates.name: starts_shape_unread
gates.reads: a shape read below a size its starts were not read at: its one size spent without a reading (631)

gates.name: not_promising
gates.reads: a rung from 262,144 for a law not shaped at its top two rungs, mostly small worlds, unsettled, or with d_V unread (629)
gates.why_not: 629: no salt buys a rung from 262,144; its other side is the laws that pass it. Under 784's let-through rule it lets 10% through, then 1%, as every gate does

gates.name: no_finite_dimension
gates.reads: no finite dimension on either chain, or undecidable twice

gates.name: no_giant_component
gates.reads: the giant component under half the graph where the rule reads

gates.name: kept_shape
gates.reads: the dimension test reads only lattice starts that kept their shape and their own d (732's tier 3): parked as a class to extend on its own (789)
gates.why_not: a gate of 784's let-through rule only, on a design's kept_shape_park: 10% through, then 1%

gates.name: repeats_a_known_result
gates.reads: the law's every chain repeats a result 100 laws already reached and kept one size up (784; named so at 835, seen_enough before)
gates.why_not: a gate of 784's let-through rule only: 10% through, then 1%, from 4,096

gates.name: early_stage
gates.reads: the clear case at 16,384, in shadow until its switch is on
gates.why_not: a label while its switch is off: what it would refuse is recorded beside the full rule's verdict

salt.buys: one rung past where the gate stops a law (537)
